judged_text: poll_feed reads i.content on every feed item with no presence check or per-item error handling, so the first item without a content element aborts the entire feed poll. For an RSS 2.0 feed whose items carry only <description> (no content:encoded) or an Atom feed using <summary>, i.content is nil and nil.scrub raises NoMethodError mid-loop; with sidekiq_options retry: false the job dies at that item on every hourly run, so no items after it are ever imported and feed polling is permanently stalled — and spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb only stubs the flag gating, never the loop body, so nothing detects it.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the loop unconditionally does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If a feed item lacks a `content` field (common for RSS 2.0 items that only have `<description>` or Atom `<summary>`), `i.content` can be `nil`, and `nil.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the entire job mid-loop. There is no per-item rescue, and `sidekiq_options retry: false` means it will keep failing on the same item each run, preventing later items from importing. The spec `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb` only tests gating and never exercises the loop body, so it wouldn’t catch this.
